issue: A true quote from any supplied evidence row could ground a covered factual aspect even when no bound accepted factual claim cited that evidence. A pure proposal's source basis could also satisfy the verdict-level source-grounding requirement for other factual text.
change: A source-based factual aspect now needs at least one bound reported/inference claim citing the exact evidenceId. Several claims can jointly answer an aspect; pure prospective requirements are not forced to invent citations. Source grounding of a pure proposal cannot replace grounding of factual answer text.
regressionCases: Exact quote from another uncited paper/version rejected
Answer with empty citations cannot borrow a source basis
Joint factual bindings remain permitted when one cites the precise basis
Pure prospective choice remains permitted without invented paper citation
Proposal source cannot substitute for factual-answer grounding
boundary: This closes an identity/audit-trail gap, not a proof of semantic completeness or actual improved model quality. Real Provider validation is currently affected by the recorded Flash outage.
